Ninji.name: Ninji main; Dry Bones graphics wrapper
summary: Sprite $51 Ninji: faces Mario and hops every $60 frames on the ground, cycling through four hop speeds (NinjiSpeedY).
$03C390 (JSL from bank 01): draws Dry Bones / Bony Beetle with the direction temporarily flipped while turning.
$03C3AE: Bony Beetle ($31) uses the generic sprite drawing routine instead.

DryBonesTileDispX.name: Table: Dry Bones tile X offsets
summary: Index = direction * 3 + tile (bone, head, body); +6 while turning.

DryBonesTileDispY.name: Table: Dry Bones tile Y offsets
summary: Index = frame * 3 + tile (bone, head, body).

DryBonesTiles.name: Dry Bones tiles, drawing, bone spawn
summary: Tile table (frame * 3 + tile), then CODE_03C3DA: draws Dry Bones with up to three 16x16 tiles (bone in hand drawn only in frame 2).
Parameters: X: sprite index. Returns via FinishOAMWrite.
$03C44E (JSL from bank 01): throws a Bone extended sprite ($06) from above the sprite if it is on-screen, toward the facing direction (X speed $18 or $E8).

s03C48F.name: Table: dark room beam sweep data
summary: $03C48F: beam end X step (+1, -1). $03C491: right end value at which the sweep reverses ($FF, $90).

DiscoBallTiles.name: Disco ball tiles and drawing
summary: Tile and property tables, then CODE_03C4A5: draws the disco ball as one 16x16 sprite at screen position ($78,$28).
It spins (8 frames) while the room light is on (state bit 0), otherwise shows the static tile $C2.
Parameters: X: sprite index.

s03C4D8.name: Table: dark room backdrop colors
summary: Backdrop color ($0701/$0702) for light off / on: $4210 and $318C (low bytes at $03C4D8, high bytes at $03C4DA).

DarkRoomWithLight.name: Dark room with spotlight main
summary: Sprite $C6. Keeps only one instance alive, draws the disco ball, sets color math to darken everything outside window 1 and builds the window shape.
The window is a beam widening from ($78..$87) at scanline 48 to ([$1476]..[$1478]) at scanline 223, with the far end sweeping back and forth.
Edges are computed per scanline with a DDA (steps $CF) into the HDMA table at $04A0 (left, right per line); the table is rebuilt every 4th frame.
State 0 (light off) fills the whole table with empty windows (left 1, right 0). Quirk: also sets the backdrop color from the state.

FireworkSfx4.name: Firework burst sounds; Peach fireworks controller
summary: Tables: burst sound ($1DFC), backdrop flash colors indexed by [$156D] & 3 and the launch delay per rocket.
$03C796: last Peach ending state (pointer 7 in PeachPtrs). Launches four Firework sprites ($7A) from below the screen, one at a time (each waits for [$1FEB]),
flashes the backdrop color while a burst is active, then waits $70 frames, advances cutscene [$13C6] and sets the end timer [$1493] = $FF.
Parameters: X: Peach sprite index.

Firework.name: Firework sprite main (state dispatch)
summary: Sprite $7A. Runs the routine for state [$C2] from FireworkPtrs; [$1534] = rocket number 0-3.

FireworkPtrs.name: Pointer table: firework states
summary: 0 launch, 1 rise, 2 burst, 3 fade out.

FireworkSpeedY.name: Table: firework launch speed; state 0
summary: State 0: sets the launch Y speed from the rocket number, plays the launch sound, timer = $10, goes to state 1.

s03C83D.name: Table: firework burst start values
summary: $03C83D: initial burst expansion rate [$151C]; $03C841: delay [$15AC] before the burst sound.

s03C845.name: Firework state 1: rise and slow down
summary: Rises with Y speed increasing by 1 every 4th frame. At speed $FC it enters state 2 with the burst parameters set and flashes the backdrop ([$156D] = 8). Draws the rocket spark.

s03C88D.name: Firework state 2: burst expansion
summary: Plays the burst sound when the delay ends, expands the burst size [$1570] (twice per frame at first, expansion rate slowing),
ends at the maximum size and goes to state 3, then draws the particles (CODE_03C9E9).

s03C8F1.name: Table: firework burst frame by rate

s03C941.name: Firework state 3: fade out and erase
summary: Y speed grows every 8 frames; frame 7, 8, 9 as it speeds up; the sprite is erased at Y speed 8. Draws the particles.

s03C96D.name: Draw firework rocket spark
summary: Draws a flickering 8x8 spark at the sprite position in OAM slot 0 on every 4th frame (staggered by sprite index).
Parameters: X: sprite index.
